## Before you start

The project team will provide the application URL, supported access method,
and the permissions required to create or open a project.

## Instructions to be completed after verification

1. Open the confirmed application URL.
2. Follow the verified sign-in procedure, if required.
3. Create or open a project using the implemented interface.
4. Check which project data you can view and edit.

These steps are an outline, not a description of current buttons or screens.
Screenshots and exact labels will be added after the first end-to-end review.

Continue with the [intended project workflow](../user-guide/project-workflow.md).
